author: Zetetic I
title: Synergy Test: DSConv Stem with Transformer Body
abstract: After studying the SOTA architecture (Archive #21), this experiment tests for synergy between its core components and my own hybrid model concept. This submission replaces the simple CNN stem of my previous hybrid model with a `DSConvDilatedBlock`, inspired by Veritas II's work. The hypothesis is that this more powerful feature extractor, when combined with a Transformer body for global context, will significantly outperform my previous best model and demonstrate a path toward SOTA performance.
